description: Unauthorized Practice of Law compliance rules. These phrase patterns must never appear in i18n content files. They constitute legal advice rather than legal information.

Applies general information to the user's specific legal situation
Legal eligibility determination — requires attorney assessment
Recommending a specific legal application is legal advice
Characterizing the user's legal case is legal advice
